content:
According to tradition, users who post on platform X using the #AppleEvent hashtag over the coming days will see a special Apple logo hashmoji attached to their posts. See below for details.

#AppleEvent hashmoji has gone live on platform X

For many years, every time Apple schedules a new event, they launch a dedicated X hashmoji to accompany the event.

Following the event invitation sent out earlier today—featuring an apple-shaped halo encircling the sun, paired with the tagline "Surprise and shine"—Apple's new hashmoji has gone live on platform X.

This means that when users post using #AppleEvent on the platform, they will see a specially designed Apple logo appear alongside the hashtag, with the design adapted from the imagery on the event invitation.

Apple's "Surprise and shine" event is scheduled for 9 September at 10 a.m. (Pacific Time). Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with the company's first foldable iPhone. Reports also indicate that new models of the Apple Watch and AirPods will be introduced.

Apple's hashmoji went live just hours after Greg Joswiak, the company's Senior Vice President of Marketing, previewed it in a post on X. Tim Cook subsequently reposted Joswiak's message and added his own comment.

Interestingly, some people have interpreted Cook's mention of "countdown" as an Easter egg, hinting at his own countdown: he is only a few days away from stepping down as Apple CEO on 1 September to take on the role of Executive Chairman of the company.

9to5Mac will be heading to Apple Park on 9 September to cover the event. Stay tuned for our coverage before, during and after the event.

Are you looking forward to this event? Let us know in the comments.
